verdict.rationale: Figma Make is an AI app builder that publishes apps to hosted infrastructure, so pre-launch security review is a fair axis. The evidence shows no platform security scan or audit. The 'Review' tab only lets the user inspect code diffs manually, and secure secret storage is a different feature. Community posts describe extracting the code to audit it yourself, which is a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the platform review my generated app for security issues before it goes live
